identification: Gould plate of Platycercus brownii (Brown's Parakeet / Northern Rosella), Birds of Australia, lithographed by Richter with Hullmandel imprint, in modern timber frame and mount. Single photo through glass: bright, even, clean paper and fairly crisp colour, which points to a modern reproduction (the Gowans Eastern Rosella 'Plate 27' framed print sold for $50 hammer in Aug 2026 looks the same kind). Cannot rule out an original from one photo.

viewing_check: Take the print out of the frame if allowed, or look closely at the edges and surface with a loupe. Original: slightly toned laid-type paper, hand-applied watercolour with visible brush strokes and gum arabic gloss, plate number and 'Birds of Australia' text, embossed plate mark, foxing or age toning, ink lines slightly crisp. Reproduction: dot-screen or flat inkjet/offset pattern under magnification, bright white modern paper, no plate mark, backing board modern. Also photograph the full bottom caption and any publisher name, and check the back for a publisher or Lucas stamp. Most likely worth about $50 to $200 as a framed reproduction.
